POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

2. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.

3. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

4. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.

8. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.

9. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Road wheels and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Vehicle body and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle Chassis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.

5. B — Information and Communication Technology

6. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

10. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. A — CPU

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
